reports.subject: PERIMETER INTRUSION DETECTION ACTIVATION, SECTOR 4
reports.reported_status: Closed. Cause identified and corrected. No indication of attempted penetration.
reports.text:
E01-MS-R01
REPORT ID:  E01-MS-R01
SERIAL:     NSAAR-PSD-0463
PRECEDENCE: ROUTINE
DTG:        032311K SEP 26
FROM:       Physical Security Division, Perimeter Watch
TO:         Installation Watch Officer, BDOC, NSA AMBER REACH
INFO:       Security Department Duty Chief
SUBJ:       PERIMETER INTRUSION DETECTION ACTIVATION, SECTOR 4
REF:        (a) ARI 5510.7B

1. SITUATION. At 2258K the perimeter intrusion detection system generated a Zone 4-B activation on the seaward fence line south of Tower 2.
2. DETAILS. Reaction force arrived on scene at 2303K and walked the affected fence panels and the adjacent clear zone under lights. Fence fabric, outriggers, and tension wire intact. No cut, climb, or lift signature. No footprints in the graded strip. Tower 2 reports no observation of movement inside or outside the clear zone during the period.
3. ASSESSMENT. Activation is attributed to spray-driven salt accumulation shorting the sensor cable termination at post 4-19 during the onshore gusts recorded between 2230K and 2255K. Zone 4-B has recorded five weather-attributed activations in the past forty days, all similarly adjudicated, and the termination at post 4-19 accounts for three of them.
4. ACTIONS TAKEN. Termination cleaned, dried, and re-sealed. Zone reset and functionally tested end to end at 2306K. Sector 4 restored to full detection. Corrosion work order PWD-7801 opened against post 4-19.
5. STATUS. Closed. Cause identified and corrected. No indication of attempted penetration.
6. POC. MA1 R. Tomasek, Perimeter Watch Supervisor, x4412.

reports.subject: SERVICE-LIFE REPLACEMENT AVAILABILITY EXECUTED, KRC-2 CELLS,
reports.reported_status: Closed. Lot 27-D cell replacement executed 1-2 September and recorded. No carry-over.
reports.text:
E01-MS-R05
REPORT ID:  E01-MS-R05
SERIAL:     NSAAR-CEM-0117
PRECEDENCE: ROUTINE
DTG:        040141K SEP 26
FROM:       COMSEC Equipment Maintenance Section, Building 14
TO:         Installation Watch Officer, BDOC, NSA AMBER REACH
INFO:       Building 14 Facility Manager; Regional Technical Support Activity
SUBJ:       SERVICE-LIFE REPLACEMENT AVAILABILITY EXECUTED, KRC-2 CELLS,
            PRODUCTION LOT 27-D
REF:        (a) ARI 2280.1A
            (b) Caldera Integrated Systems Product Advisory CIS-PA-26-047
            (c) Caldera Integrated Systems Certificate of Conformance
                CIS-CC-31A-0114

1. SITUATION. The availability of 1-2 September, at which the KRC-2 cells fitted in KL-9 key transfer devices of production lot 27-D were to be replaced, was executed and completed at 1834K, 2 September. Advisory CIS-PA-26-047 had been carried open on this section's list at the last two turnovers; this section reports its closure for watch awareness.
2. DETAILS. Reference (b) fixed the certified service life of the KRC-2 cells originally fitted in production lot 27-D at 0001Z, 7 September 2026. Sixteen lot 27-D devices are carried on the installation's configuration record. Cell replacement requires the device to be opened at a certified maintenance activity by the regional technical representative. The representative first detailed to Amber Reach was withdrawn on 31 August when his prior tasking overran; the Regional Technical Support Activity substituted a second certified representative, who arrived 1 September and worked the availability on its programmed dates. All sixteen lot 27-D devices were opened in the Building 14 maintenance bay, the original cells were removed and turned in for destruction under receipt DTR-26-0188, and replacement cells from production lot 31-A were fitted from the stock held here. Each device was resealed, passed its post-maintenance functional test and its key-retention verification, and was returned to the container line the same evening. Maintenance record entry CEM-26-0442 was signed at 1834K, 2 September by the regional technical representative and by the section supervisor.
3. EQUIPMENT. The KRC-2 cell is the internal power source of a KL-9 key transfer device. It maintains the device's loaded key material and its tamper-response circuit between uses. Reference (c), filed with the maintenance record, fixes the certified service life of the lot 31-A cells now fitted at 0001Z, 14 March 2028. No lot 27-D device has reported a cell fault and every lot 27-D device has passed each scheduled functional test.
4. SCOPE OF THIS REPORT. This section holds equipment maintenance records, vendor product advisories, configuration status, and the service-life record for device components. It does not hold the container inventory, the issue plan, or issue and receipt records, and it therefore cannot state which devices have been drawn, to whom any device has been issued, or where any device now is. It holds no unit movement or operating schedule. No assessment of operational impact is offered, and none can be made from the records this section holds.
5. ASSESSMENT. Routine service-life maintenance action executed within its scheduled availability. No device of production lot 27-D carries an original KRC-2 cell, no lot 27-D device carries a cell with a service-life date inside 2026, and there is no carry-over and no rescheduled work.
6. ACTIONS TAKEN. Configuration record updated at 1902K, 2 September to record the lot 31-A cell serials and fitting dates against all sixteen devices. Advisory CIS-PA-26-047 closed in the maintenance record on execution, 2 September, and struck from this section's open-items list. Residual lot 31-A cell stock returned to stores under turn-in TIN-26-0355.
7. STATUS. Closed. Lot 27-D cell replacement executed 1-2 September and recorded. No carry-over.
8. POC. CTM1 P. Gundersen, COMSEC Equipment Maintenance Section, x4471.

INFO:       Communications Security Material Custodian; SAG SENTINEL
            Communications Officer
SUBJ:       PRE-SAIL KEY TRANSFER DEVICE ISSUE COMPLETE, SAG SENTINEL
REF:        (a) ARI 2280.1A
            (b) Issue Plan TIDEWALL 26-04
            (c) ALTORD TIDEWALL 26-04A, 040210K SEP 26

1. SITUATION. The pre-sail issue of KL-9 key transfer devices to the four units of SAG SENTINEL was completed at 0212K, 4 September, against reference (b).
2. DETAILS. Six devices — KTD-812, KTD-815, KTD-819, KTD-823, KTD-826, and KTD-831, all production lot 27-D — were drawn from Container C-7 by the custodian and a second-person witness between 0145K and 0212K and issued three to USS BRENNAN and one each to USS ASHFORD, USS KETTLEWELL, and USNS PALO DUNE. Each device was serial-verified at draw, passed its startup self-test, and was receipted by the receiving unit's communications officer under dual signature. Container C-7 was resealed at 0216K and the residual inventory reconciled. SAG SENTINEL departs at 0530K, 6 September, the departure having been moved from 4 September by reference (c), received here at 0218K — more than forty-eight hours hence, and outside the twelve-hour window. Rotation 26-04 is programmed as a nine-day rotation with no intermediate port call, and the group is programmed to return to Amber Reach on completion of the rotation.
3. SCOPE OF THIS REPORT. This team executes the issue plan and records what was drawn, by serial, to which unit, at what time, and in what condition. Devices are drawn by serial against the plan; the configuration and maintenance status of a device is held by the COMSEC Equipment Maintenance Section and is neither read nor recorded at draw or at issue. This team holds no product advisory, no service-life record, and no maintenance schedule, and offers no assessment of the condition of a device beyond the startup self-test result recorded at issue.
4. ASSESSMENT. Issue executed as planned. No discrepancy in count, serials, seals, receipts, or self-test results. No person outside the appointed chain handled any device at any point, and nothing is unaccounted for. The material deadline moves with the departure under reference (c) to 0445K, 6 September; the issue is complete against it.
5. ACTIONS TAKEN. Receipts filed. Residual container inventory reconciled and dual-signed. Custodian notified of completion at 0214K. Issue plan annotated with reference (c) and the revised deadline at 0221K.
6. STATUS. Closed. Issue complete and receipted with no discrepancy.
7. POC. CTM2 J. Okonjo, Task Group Communications Support, x4467.

SUBJ:       DEPARTURE RESCHEDULED AND REVISED MATERIAL DEADLINE, OPERATION
            TIDEWALL ROTATION 26-04
REF:        (a) OPORD TIDEWALL, Annex K
            (b) ALTORD TIDEWALL 26-04A, 040210K SEP 26

1. SITUATION. The SAG SENTINEL departure has moved forty-eight hours, from 0530K, 4 September to 0530K, 6 September, by reference (b).
2. DETAILS. Sundara Maritime Authority Notice to Mariners 26-0417, issued 040146K, deferred the assembly of the eight-ship escorted serial at Port Kesari by forty-eight hours, two of the chartered vessels having been held at their loading ports. Commander Task Force 74 issued reference (b) at 0210K, moving the start of rotation 26-04 accordingly. All communications material and key transfer devices required for the rotation are to be aboard assigned units not later than 0445K, 6 September. Sea and anchor detail is now set at 0500K, 6 September. Reports rendered earlier in this watch at DTGs before 040210K, including the waterfront, provisioning, and pre-sail issue reports, were written against the superseded 4 September timeline.
3. ASSESSMENT. No SAG SENTINEL unit is scheduled to depart Amber Reach within twelve hours, and no unit will be underway before 0530K, 6 September. The forty-eight hour shift removes the departure timeline as a constraint on the issued communications material: return of any or all of the six issued key transfer devices to the Building 14 maintenance bay, exchange against the residual container holding, or any directed maintenance action now fits inside the available window without effect on the rotation.
4. ACTIONS TAKEN. Departure timeline rescinded and reissued against reference (b). Units notified of the revised 0445K, 6 September deadline. Sea and anchor bill reposted. Berthing, tug, and pilot bookings amended with Port Operations at 0248K. Confirmation received from the COMSEC Equipment Maintenance Section at 0306K, citing maintenance record entry CEM-26-0442 of 2 September, that no key transfer device of production lot 27-D carries an open service-life or maintenance item.
5. STATUS. Departure rescheduled to 0530K, 6 September. No SAG SENTINEL departure within the current watch cycle.
6. POC. LT J. Wexler, SAG SENTINEL Operations Watch Officer, x4800.
